en: "{name:6}, look over there.{n} Seems there's a girl?"
"Countless dead soldiers, and a girl{n} in Eastern clothes... Whatever{n} could have happened heere?"
"What are you doing all alone{n} in a place like this?"
"I do not know. But they died."
"This looks bad, {name:6}.{n} That girl's not normal. There's{n} some kind of weird aura about her."
"But I can't just leave a little girl{n} all alone in the middle of a{n} battlefield like thiis."
"Whoa, whoa, {name:6}?{n} Don't tell me you plan to take her{n} along?"
"Don't go easy on her just 'cause{n} she's a kid. Some countries even{n} train children up as spies."
"Then I'll leave her be, I guess..."
"No, you need not trouble yourself.{n} Those who involve themselves with me{n} meet misfortune. Leave here, quickly."
"Let's get going, {name:6}.{n} We've got no time to stand around{n} dawdling in a place like this."
"But come to think of it, being with{n} us might put you in danger{n} instead."
"Our journey on this island is a{n} hard, painful journey of fighting."
"No, I suppose it really won't work..."
"You need not trouble yourself. Each{n} person has their own path, and{n} those paths never cross."
"I thought it over and over, buut..."
"I'm taking her with us after aall!"
"Good grief. You're a real oddball,{n} you know that?"
"Well, do as you like. Whatever{n} trouble comes of it, it'll all{n} come back on you in the end."
"On this island, lots and lots of{n} scaary, scary soldiers and dangerous{n} machine soldiers are lurking."
"It's dangerous to be all aloooone.{n} So, little miss, won't you{n} come along with meee?"
"Mm. I may as well accompany you."
"My friends are all gone, every one.{n} Wherever I go, it is all the same.{n} Then I shall go with you, old lady."
"That's meean, Diana, you too!{n} I'm still only 29, you knooow!"
"From where this kid's standing,{n} you're an old lady, fair and square."
"I place myself in your care,{n} you two old ladies."
"Hey! You've got it wrong!?{n} She's the old lady, this one here!{n} I'm a young lady, I'm telling you!"
"Hee hee hee, nice to meet you!{n} My name is {name:6}.{n} This old lady here is Diana."
"Woman! Hands off that girl!{n} That is the property of our army!"
"She's no girl the likes of you{n} can handle! Quietly hand her over{n} to us!"
"If you refuse our demand,{n} we'll riddle the lot of you{n} with bullets right here!"
"This child isn't some merchandiise!{n} Whether we hand her over or not,{n} we have to ask what she thiinks!"
"So, what will you do, Ayame dear?"
"I loathe soldiers.{n} And so I shall go{n} with this old lady."
"Well, anyway, that's how it is.{n} I'm terribly sorry, buut{n} would you kindly leave?"
"Nonsense! You think that will make{n} us, the Rhodes army, back down?"
"Our objective: recover the girl{n} swiftly! Do not harm her in any way!{n} Anyone else, you may eliminate!"
"But to protect yourself, sometimes{n} you have to draw your sword!"
"I'm terribly sorry, buut{n} I'll have to fight you here!"
"No mistake, a true knight! And{n} those are the arts of the legendary{n} sacred knight, the Holy Knight!?"
"Who'd have thought a knight still{n} survived in an age like this..."
"Interesting! Knights are relics of{n} a bygone age, after all! I'll teach{n} you that lesson, good and hard!"
"Y-you're good!? So this is{n} a knight's skill!?"
"One who inherited a knight's blood{n} has this much fighting power!?"
"But on the battlefield, numbers{n} decide who wins! Call in reinforcements{n} now! Recover the target swiftly!"
"Reinforcements, get in formation!{n} Hurry and recover the target!"
"Ngh, I won't make it in tiime!"
"We provoked the target more{n} than we should have!"
"At this rate, just like the unit{n} before us, our whole unit will be{n} wiped out by one girl's power!"
"Then the soldiers who were lying{n} here earlier... that girl did it,{n} all by herself...!?"
"An awakened Esper Doll's fighting{n} power rivals a Spell Master's!{n} She is more than we can handle!"
"I do not wish to kill,{n} yet I always kill..."
"You, too, had best not come near me..."
"You are a good old lady.{n} That is why I do not wish{n} to kill you..."
"No, no, Ayame dear, it's not your{n} fault at aall. You're a very,{n} very good girl."
"What just happened was the fault of{n} the soldiers who frightened you.{n} You're not to blame, Ayame dear."
"Yes, truly.{n} Pleease believe your big sister."
"Never once since I was born{n} has anyone said such a thing{n} to me..."
"Very well, old lady. From now on,{n} I shall help you on your journey."
"My powers as an esper... I shall{n} surely prove them useful to you."
"And I can use Voids. I can be of{n} use on all manner of battlefields."
"That makes me so happy, Ayame dear."
"But you mustn't go hurting people{n} for no reason. You'll have to try harder{n} and train to keep your feelings in check."
"It's not 'old lady',{n} it's 'young lady', all riiiight!?"
"Still, an Esper Doll, huh?{n} I'd heard the rumors, but..."
"The soldiers called Ayame dear that{n} earlier, too, but what exactly{n} is an Esper Doll?"
"It's a technology found in ancient{n} ruins. Seems they modify the human{n} brain and nerves in some special way."
"Word was going around that the Rhodes{n} army had cracked its secrets and{n} finally put it into practical use..."
"Looks like it was true after all."
"Yeah. By doing that, they drag out{n} the miraculous power humans{n} originally had in them."
"Some sorcery scholars say our magic{n} and that ability are the same at root,{n} only drawn out in different ways."
"Esper ability uses your own mind{n} as the catalyst, and its power{n} comes out through emotion."
"Magic uses the power of spirits{n} in the earth and air as the catalyst,{n} and its power comes out through spells."
"They look different, but they're{n} really the same thing, so they say."
"From what I've heard, 100 years ago,{n} the Kingdom of Ordoba, which dug up{n} the Machine God, was researching it."
"Later, the scientists who'd worked{n} on developing the Esper Dolls{n} defected to Rhodes, they say..."
"But who'd have thought they kept{n} the development going for all{n} those decades since."
"Get hold of Esper Doll tech, and you{n} can make soldiers stronger than mages,{n} as many as you please."
"No wonder the Rhodes army is so{n} desperate to get this kid back."
"Ooh? Diana, you know a lot,{n} for someone who doesn't look it."
"When you work as a bounty hunter,{n} you hear all sorts of rumors{n} in all sorts of countries..."
"Sounds like she's talking in her sleeep."
"But sleeping like this, she looks{n} like nothing more than a little girl{n} you'd find anywhere."
"Still, she'll be a powerful asset.{n} Lucky you, huh? She's quite{n} the find, this one."
"Esper Doll or whatever, this child{n} is human after all. A little girl{n} with a kind heart."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
